mapper.select: SELECT sv.booking_pass_id,a.has_published FROM tb_golden_slot_booking_pass sv LEFT JOIN tb_golden_slot_activity a ON a.booking_pass_id=sv.booking_pass_id
SELECT sv.*,v.status+0 AS status FROM tb_golden_slot_booking_pass sv JOIN tb_booking_pass v ON v.id=sv.booking_pass_id WHERE sv.booking_pass_id=#{bookingPassId}
SELECT a.total_stock,s.stock FROM tb_golden_slot_activity a JOIN tb_golden_slot_booking_pass s USING(booking_pass_id) WHERE booking_pass_id=#{bookingPassId}
